native_design.reuse_prior: Only successful copies at INT_TOL=1e-4; use physical Celsius=T_K-273.15.

temperature_conversion: New native cases use T_K=T_C+273.15; archived 273-offset runs enter at actual Kelvin-derived Celsius, never silently relabelled.

solver.unchanged: GEAR, NEWTON, reaction network, thermophysical model, feed, pressure, diameter, tube count

model: New continuous two-input simulator surrogate; old six-Ea fixed-condition surrogates are not extrapolated.
scope: Nominal kinetics and original surrogate thermophysical representation; 100-308 C extends beyond the old operating study, not experimental validation.
validation: Reserved native points are not used in training or selection. Any adaptive additions remain training. Check finalists with direct Aspen.

screening_criteria.native: Completed report; finite positive target, nonnegative components within 1e-10 kg/h, total mass residual <=0.01 kg/h, chemical C/H/O relative residual <=0.001, max device energy residual <=0.01 kW.
screening_criteria.surrogate: Report heldout R2, RMSE, median/maximum relative error and log10 RMSE separately. Provisional field use targets: median relative error <=2%, 95th percentile <=5% for target mass and both CF fields. Char judged with absolute and relative errors separately because near-zero values span many orders of magnitude.
screening_criteria.extrema: Native rerun predicted target maximum and CF minima, independent of fitting; these are single-criterion grid extrema, not uncertainty-robust utility winners.

batch_execution_revision.reason: Aspen IAPMON.3 history-size interruption in reused documents
batch_execution_revision.resolution: One fresh Aspen document and unique working directory per native point; retain failed attempts; same physics and integration tolerance
batch_execution_revision.candidate_kernels: RBF, Matern 5/2, Matern 3/2 with estimated noise, Matern 3/2 with fixed 1e-8 noise; selection uses training-only CV. The fixed-noise alternative tests smoothing bias before reserved validation is examined.
